messages:
nick: Hey — CI turned red on my PR #4823, failing TestKVCacheEviction on matrix shard 3. Full workflow run id is 1234567890. Is there a quick way to rerun just that shard and avoid a full image rebuild?

ci-bot: CI • workflow "linux-matrix" failed • run_id: 1234567890 • failed job: linux-matrix-3 • see: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890

zoe: You can rerun the job-level ID from GitHub UI by clicking the job then "Re-run jobs" — it usually doesn't rebuild images if the runner image is cached.

nick: UI is fine but want a scripted way (CI is noisy during office hours).

ash: If you have the job id (not the run id) you can use gh api to rerun the job: `gh api -X POST /repos/:owner/:repo/actions/jobs/<<job_id>>/rerun` — that targets the single job.

nick: Nice — how do I get the job id quickly?

zoe: Open the job in GH UI and inspect the URL: it has `jobs/<job_id>` at the end, or use `gh run view 1234567890 --json jobs -q '.jobs[] | select(.name=="linux-matrix-3") | .id'` to fetch it.

ash: Example: `JOB_ID=$(gh run view 1234567890 --json jobs -q '.jobs[] | select(.name=="linux-matrix-3") | .id') && gh api -X POST /repos/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/jobs/$JOB_ID/rerun`

mira: Note: our infra honors `NO_IMAGE_REBUILD=1` on reruns for matrix jobs — set that env var in the rerun request (or via the UI "Re-run jobs with inputs") to avoid image rebuild. Without it the pipeline may spin up a fresh build which rebuilds docker images.

nick: How do I pass that from the gh api call?

mira: We have a small wrapper: `scripts/ci/rerun-job --run 1234567890 --job linux-matrix-3 --no-image` — it looks up job id, calls the API and sets NO_IMAGE_REBUILD for the retry. Use that one if you want the safe path.

nick: Perfect — running `./scripts/ci/rerun-job --run 1234567890 --job linux-matrix-3 --no-image` now.

ci-bot: CI • rerun requested for job linux-matrix-3 (run 1234567890) by nick — preserve-image=true

ash: Heads up — if the failure is flaky and depends on cached state (kv tests), sometimes preserving image still triggers fresh infra bits; if it flakes again, try `--preserve-kv-cache` flag on the script so it reuses the cached test fixture.

nick: Got it — added `--preserve-kv-cache` as well. Running.

infra-sre: pinging — if the rerun tries to rebuild and needs image cache warmed, I can bump cache retention for a few minutes.

mira: thanks! if infra toggles anything, please note it in the thread so ops runbooks stay in sync :+)

ash: If anyone prefers GH CLI only: minimal steps are: 1) `gh run view 1234567890 --json jobs -q '.jobs[] | select(.name=="linux-matrix-3") | .id'` 2) `gh api -X POST /repos/$OWNER/$REPO/actions/jobs/$JOB_ID/rerun` 3) confirm runner logs. But that won't set our NO_IMAGE_REBUILD flag unless you call our wrapper.
thread: nick started thread about rerunning a failing matrix shard and avoiding image rebuild; brief back-and-forth with CLI hints and an internal wrapper script.
